snippet.title: Rise of Valor - Android Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
FOR MORE ANDROID GAMES -http://www.youtube.com/user/androidgameplaynet?sub_confirmation=1
Play for free and try to conquer the world your own way. Rise of Valor let you the chance to play with historical units and heroes, in real battles of the past. You will need tactical minding to get over the epical campaign. 
AWESOME FEATURES:
CONQUER THE WORLD
Conquer more than 20 battles, strategically and tactically. Gain power toward your expansion and defend your assizes!
HISTORICAL & UNIQUE BATTLES
Each battlefield is unique and represents Great Battles of the past.
Will you be strong enough to rewrite the course of History with your Army?
MASTER HISTORIC UNITS
Decide which historic units will follow your commands.
FIGHT WITH REAL GREAT HEROES
Lead your troops inside tactical battles with Napoleon, Nefertiti and Joan of Arc. Each of them having special skills and attributes to bring to the battlefields. There’s no need to say more!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Download link - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aenetworks.riseofvalor
